title: v5.103.13 shipped: HVAC receives EC constraint at boot (restart-day pre-cool restored)
summary: HVAC receives EC constraint at boot (restart-day pre-cool restored)
why: Surfaced live by the v5.103.12 pre_cool_skip_reason obs (no_constraint post-restart while EC computed normal). Read-only trace root-caused: EC-before-HVAC registration + fire-and-forget dispatch + non-change suppression = HVAC never gets the constraint object until a mode change. Fix is HVAC-pull-at-setup (parsimonious vs manager-reorder or EC re-dispatch). Reviews: A/B SHIP, B caught a D7-dwell regression the pull introduced (fixed), C caught the tests were hollow (source-greps) -> rewrote to 8 behavioral tests. Orchestrator INDEPENDENTLY mutation-verified on the shipping code cache-clean (earlier worktree verify was invalid - wrong import path + stale pyc): pull-neuter REDs the ordering test, field-drop REDs the payload test.
implications: Shipped HVAC-PRECOOL-NO-CONSTRAINT-POST-BOOT-1 at v5.103.13; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.13.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After a restart in the 10am-2pm window, sensor.ura_hvac_coordinator_mode.pre_cool_skip_reason is NOT no_constraint (HVAC holds the constraint object); energy_constraint_since/duration_s survive a coast-window restart (no zeroing); zero URA ERROR

refs.release_notes: Post-restart, HVAC missed the EC's fire-and-forget SIGNAL_ENERGY_CONSTRAINT (subscribed after dispatch) and stayed constraint=None until evening coast, disabling Path A afternoon pre-cool on restart mornings. Fix: producer-owned _build_energy_constraint() (single source), HVAC pulls current_energy_constraint() at end of async_setup (ordering-proof, guarded, idempotent); D7 dwell resume-if-same preserved. 3 framing-disjoint reviews + fix-up + orchestrator mutation-verify.
